_comment: Deterministic gate definitions for cmd/gates. Replaces the prose in
coder.md Phase 4/4.5 and critical-review-dispatch.md Phase 3.0.1-3.0.3 that
asked a model to run commands and paste the output.
MODULE SCOPE — the thing the prose got wrong. evenplay-mono has NO root
go.mod and no go.work: every app is its own module
(apps/finance-domain/wallet, apps/platform-domain/{bay-session,core},
apps/game-domain/engine, libs/*, tools/*). So `go build ./...` from the repo
root fails outright — there is no root module. Gates with scope 'module' are
run once per module that owns a changed file, with cwd set to that module
root. Only scope 'repo' gates run from the worktree root.
TRIGGERS are derived from the run state's classification, never from a flag a
caller might forget:
always              every run
high_or_critical    classification.risk in {high, critical}
financial           classification.components intersects the money set
(wallet, bet-settlement, bet-placement, jackpot)
has_benchmarks      the module has at least one `func Benchmark` in a
package owning a changed file
declared            applicability lives in the Task Assignment, which gates
cannot see. Pass -declare <gate> to require it. Not
declared is recorded as skipped with a reason — never as
a pass.
iteration           only on -phase iteration (post-fix domain regression)
A required gate that cannot run (missing tool, missing rules file) FAILS.
Waive explicitly with -waive <gate>=<reason>; the reason lands in the run
state. There is no status that means 'we did not check but it is fine'.

build.note: Compile before testing — a build failure makes every later gate meaningless.

test.note: Also the data source for the coverage gate — one run, two gates.

coverage.note: Parses the test gate's per-package coverage lines against coverage_floors. A changed package reporting [no test files] fails unless it matches coverage_exempt.

lint.note: Never trust an agent's self-reported gofmt/vet — PR 1294 shipped a gofmt failure that way.

complexity.note: Cyclomatic < 15, nesting < 7, params < 7, fan-out < 10. Named-pattern overrides are validated by the reviewer, not here.

semgrep.note: Project invariants. A missing rules file fails the gate rather than passing quietly — that file IS the gate.

mutation.note: Takes a PATH, not a Go package pattern: `gremlins unleash .` generates mutants, `gremlins unleash ./...` matches nothing, prints "No results to report." and EXITS 0 — a vacuous pass, caught by running it for real on 2026-07-31. The binary is `gremlins`, NOT `gremlins-go` — role files said gremlins-go for months, which is command-not-found. Subcommand is `unleash` (aliases run/r) and it operates on a MODULE, not a ./pkg/... pattern. --threshold-efficacy does NOT affect the exit code (80.77% against a threshold of 95 still exits 0, verified 2026-07-31), so cmd/gates parses the efficacy and enforces mutation_min_score itself; an unparsable score fails closed. Zero generated mutants is also a failure, because a vacuous run reads as a pass.

bench_relative.note: Runs on the base worktree and the head worktree, then benchstat. Fails on any row over bench_max_regression_pct.

bench_absolute.note: p99 latency and throughput floor come from the Task Assignment; gates cannot invent them. Declare with -declare bench_absolute and pass -bench-absolute-command.

differential.note: Only applies when Phase 1 found no reference implementation. Declare with -declare differential.

domain_suite.note: The pre-re-review gate from iteration-protocol.md: a targeted fix can regress a sibling whose tests a changed-files-only run skips.
